I want to explain something before you get annoyed with me.

"What will you be, beta?"
"IAS officer!" Deepak said each time, proudly. Like his uncle. Like his mother had wanted.

"But what do they do all day?"
Deepak opened his mouth. He didn't know. He only knew that when he said it, everyone smiled and nobody asked anything else. It felt safe.
"Doesn't matter," he said. "I'll be one."
